concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Concept canoe cavity and third-vane direction useful, but bead-like dorsal ornaments and tall sail exaggerate. Build one continuous closed thin three-vane fossil volume with two upcurved lateral quilted wings, modest central upright quilted vane along common keel seam, glide-offset unbranched module relief. No dorsal beads, roots or mouth. Small irregular matrix supports lower keel; display posture inferential, not living reconstruction.
